newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BLATTER HAPPY WITH WORLD CUP STADIUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLATTER HAPPY WITH WORLD CUP STADIUM.

text.p: FIFA general secretary Sepp Blatter said on Thursday he was pleased with the World Cup preparations at Marseille's Velodrome stadium, one of the venues for the 1998 finals.
"The balance is very satisfying. Marseille, like France, has understood perfectly the philosophy of FIFA which is to make durable constructions," Blatter said.
"The World Cup is not en ephemeral event. It's not a circus which folds up its big top as soon as the spectacle is over."
Blatter was also due to visit Montpellier later on Thursday and Toulouse on Friday during his tour of southern venues.
